# eth.tx.taxi

> Public Ethereum mainnet explorer in the tx.taxi family. Read-only blocks, transactions, accounts, tokens, gas estimates and provider-observed pending activity.

## Canonical pages

- [eth.tx.taxi](https://eth.tx.taxi/): Track Ethereum blocks, transactions, addresses, and live gas conditions on eth.tx.taxi.
- [Blocks](https://eth.tx.taxi/blocks/1): See recent Ethereum blocks with validator, gas usage, transaction count, rewards, and fees.
- [Recent Transactions](https://eth.tx.taxi/txs): See recent Ethereum transactions with value, gas used, and gas price, updated in real time.
- [Ethereum Block Production](https://eth.tx.taxi/production): Follow recent Ethereum blocks, fee recipients, gas usage, transaction activity, and the live gas market.
- [Pending transaction sample](https://eth.tx.taxi/mempool-block/0): See observed Ethereum pending transactions, gas-price ranges, gas limits, and estimated execution fees for the next validator slot.
- [About eth.tx.taxi](https://eth.tx.taxi/about): Learn about eth.tx.taxi, its Ethereum data sources, open-source lineage, and operator contact details.
- [Privacy Policy](https://eth.tx.taxi/privacy-policy): How eth.tx.taxi handles the limited technical data required to operate its Ethereum explorer.
- [Terms of Service](https://eth.tx.taxi/terms-of-service): Terms for using eth.tx.taxi, an independent Ethereum block explorer operated by tx.taxi.
- [Ethereum Guide](https://eth.tx.taxi/docs/faq): Understand Ethereum transactions, gas, account activity, confirmations, and the data shown by eth.tx.taxi.
- [REST API](https://eth.tx.taxi/docs/api/rest): Documentation for the eth.tx.taxi REST API: blocks, transactions, accounts, tokens, gas estimates, and explorer state.
- [WebSocket API](https://eth.tx.taxi/docs/api/websocket): Documentation for the eth.tx.taxi WebSocket API: live Ethereum blocks, pending transactions, accounts, and transaction status.

## Documented interfaces

REST base: https://eth.tx.taxi
WebSocket endpoint: wss://eth.tx.taxi/api/v1/ws

- GET /api/v1/init-data: Explorer snapshot
- GET /api/v1/info: Network status
- GET /api/v1/fees/recommended: Recommended gas prices
- GET /api/v1/mempool: Pending sample summary
- GET /api/v1/blocks: Recent blocks
- GET /api/v1/blocks/:height: Blocks ending at a height
- GET /api/block-height/:height: Block hash at a height
- GET /api/v1/block/:hash: Block by hash
- GET /api/block/:hash/txs/:start: Block transactions
- GET /api/tx/:hash: Transaction by hash
- GET /api/tx/:hash/status: Transaction inclusion status
- GET /api/v1/ethereum/transaction/:hash: Ethereum transaction metadata
- GET /api/address/:address: Account summary
- GET /api/address/:address/txs: Account transactions
- GET /api/v1/ethereum/address/:address: Ethereum account metadata
- GET /api/v1/ethereum/token/:address: Token metadata
- GET /api/v1/ethereum/token/:address/transfers: Token transfers

## Limits

Documented routes are public `GET` endpoints and return JSON unless noted. Hash and address parameters are 0x-prefixed hexadecimal values. Amounts and quantities that require precision are decimal strings; do not parse them with JavaScript `Number`.

This is a read API. It does not broadcast transactions, estimate gas for arbitrary call data, provide execution traces, serve raw transaction bytes, or promise complete account history while indexer fallback is active.

No. eth.tx.taxi displays public Ethereum data. It cannot access wallets, undo a transaction, retrieve a private key, or recover funds. Contact the wallet, exchange, bridge, or application that submitted the transaction for account-specific support.

Full documentation: https://eth.tx.taxi/llms-full.txt
